lines.text: Show it. Say it. Paste it. Meet VibiusMaximus.
Hold Control Space and just talk. It runs offline, in any app, right where your cursor is.
Alt Shift S freezes the screen. Drag over what to change.
Draw a box, then Alt P drops numbered pins. Say a note for each.
Hold Control Space for the main request.
Rambled? Control K turns it into a clean instruction.
Press Enter. The marked-up image goes into your chat, then the numbered notes.
Terminals get a file path instead, ready for Claude Code.
Bigger ask? Alt Shift B opens a board for screenshots, design options and notes.
Control Enter sends all six images in order, labelled to match the prompt.
and a saved prompt lands right at your cursor.
Got a wall of text back? Type your follow-up,
then Alt 4 adds your summary prompt. One key, your favourite prompts.
Zero CPU when idle. Windows only when you use them. An eighteen megabyte installer.
VibiusMaximus. Show it, say it, paste it.
